and  HONOURABLE MS. JUSTICE NISHA M. THAKORE  Date : 05/03/2025

COMMON ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE A.S. SUPEHIA)
1.
Learned AGP has submitted that all the amount including the interest is already paid to the applicants.
There is substantial implementation of Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/117/2025 ORDER DATED: 05/03/2025 undefined 2.

Learned advocate Mr.Patel has submitted that though the applicants have received the amount of interest @ 15% however, there is discrepancy in the calculation and payment, as the applicants would be entitled to the interest as directed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court till actual payment is made.
It is submitted that liberty may be reserved in favour of the applicants to file appropriate proceedings for claiming the amount for delayed payment of the interest for a particular period.

3. In this view of the matters, the present applications stand disposed of with the aforesaid liberty,
reserved in faour of the applicants.
Registry to place a copy of this order in each of the connected matters.

Sd/-
(A. S. SUPEHIA, J) Sd/-
